title: Jim Semivan told Ryan Bledsoe the family may be hybrids

tellings.quote: Semivan purportedly told him, "You know, we think you're hybrids. The reason you're having these experiences is because you may have more non-human DNA

plain: A man named Jim Semivan is said to have told Ryan Bledsoe, from a family reporting strange experiences, that the family may be part human and part something else. The researcher Jason Simosa says Semivan reportedly told him, "we think you're hybrids," and that the experiences happen because they "may have more non-human DNA." If true, it would explain why one family keeps having these encounters.
